services.name: Build Pottery-Make a Clay Platter
services.desc: Make your own themed clay platter! A few design options available. Join our fun hand-building workshop. Shape unique pottery by hand. No experience is needed. We guide you step-by-step. All clay, tools, and firing are included. Workshop Details - Technique: Easy hand-building (pinch, coil, and slab methods) - Includes: All materials, professional glazing, and final kiln firing - Skill Level: Perfect for total beginners and creative makers Week 1 * Roll and shape your clay slab * Add custom themed textures and edges * Pieces will be fired by instructor before week 2 Week 2 * Paint your piece with vibrant glazes * Pieces will be fired again by instructor and available for pick up in a week

blurb: We have relocated to a wonderful storefront in Eden! It is to the right of the Post Office in the plaza with Eats of Eden and Luna and Lavender. Our mission and offerings will remain the same : "Supporting the Creative Arts in Ogden Valley".
